points.why: The answer never asks who coordinates the drivers or frames the bunching as emergent behavior arising from many independent drivers following local rules.
It mentions agent-based modeling, but only when drivers differ from one another, and it defaults to the aggregate model rather than flagging emergence as the reason aggregates may fail.

It treats dispatch as limiting airport outflow and includes surge pricing in a decision loop, but never singles out the platform's rules as assigned coordination or as a leverage point separate from driver behavior.
